title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Effective date: January 1, 2025
intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.p1Body: When you create an account or place an order we collect your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information. Optional fields include a display name (Friendly Name), phone number, and SMS marketing preferences.
s1.p2Body: When you visit our site we may collect your IP address, browser type, pages visited, and referring URLs through standard server logs and analytics tools.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
items: Send order confirmations, shipping notifications, and support responses.
Send marketing emails or SMS messages, only if you have opted in.
Improve our website and product offerings.

s3.title: 3. Third-Party Services
s3.intro: We use the following third-party services which may receive some of your data:
items: Google / GitHub — optional social sign-in (only if you choose to use it).
Payment processors (e.g. Stripe) — to handle transactions securely.
Email marketing platforms (e.g. Klaviyo) — if you subscribe to our mailing list.
s3.outro: These providers are contractually obligated to handle your data securely and only for the purposes we specify. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

s4.title: 4. Cookies
s4.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and analyse site traffic. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are necessary for the site to function. You can opt out of analytics cookies through your browser settings.

s5.title: 5. Data Retention
s5.body: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active. Order data is retained for 7 years to comply with tax and financial regulations. You may request deletion of your account at any time (see Section 6).

s6.title: 6. Your Rights
s6.intro: Depending on your location, you may have rights including:
items: Access — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Correction — ask us to fix inaccurate data.
Deletion — request that we delete your account and associated data.
Opt-out — unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time.
Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
s6.outro: To exercise any of these rights, <contactLink>contact us</contactLink> or email <privacyEmailLink>privacy@sawdustandscents.com</privacyEmailLink>.

s7.title: 7. Security
s7.body: We use industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, secure password hashing, and role-based access controls. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security but we take every reasonable precaution to protect your data.

s8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
s8.body: Our site is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or by a prominent notice on the site. The effective date at the top of this page will always reflect the most recent version.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.body: Questions or concerns about your privacy? <contactLink>Send us a message</contactLink> or email <privacyEmailLink>privacy@sawdustandscents.com</privacyEmailLink>.
